headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 7, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Zac Thornton earning the win. Marcus Semien led the Mets' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other action, the Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 5-4, with Josh Smith leading the Blue Jays' offense. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels 7-0, while the New York Yankees took down the Atlanta Braves 5-4.

Several teams suffered injuries, including the Tampa Bay Rays, who placed 2B Ben Williamson on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners placed RHP Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins placed RHP Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, due to a left glute strain. The Chicago White Sox placed LHP Chris Murphy on the 15-day injured list with a left flexor strain and C Joey Bart on the 10-day injured list with a fifth metacarpal fracture in his left hand.

Several trades and roster moves were announced, including the Miami Marlins trading RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Kansas City Royals acquired 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Zac Thornton earning the win. Marcus Semien led the Mets' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Phillies in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 5-4. Josh Smith led the Blue Jays' offense with a strong performance, collecting 3 hits, including a home run, and driving in 1 run.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 3-5 decision to the Washington Nationals, unable to overcome a strong performance from the home team. Daylen Lile led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 3-2 in a closely contested game. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Ben Rice led the Braves' offense, while Chris Sale and Gerrit Cole had strong performances for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a one-sided matchup, securing a 7-0 victory. Impact players for the Marlins included Wade Meckler, Xavier Edwards, Otto Lopez, and Griffin Conine, while Sandy Alcantara led the pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Ben Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The move is retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster, bringing his skills to the team.
